title: Second special sitting of 2025

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/20/2025/ޚޞ/2).

From the Speaker's desk: the President's submission for appointing members to the Anti-Corruption Commission, under Article 199(h) of the Constitution and Article 4(n) of the Anti-Corruption Commission Act (Law No. 13/2008), is sent to the relevant standing committee for review.

Report of the Human Rights and Gender Committee on its review of the President's nominee for Vice President of the Human Rights Commission of the Maldives under Article 8(a) of the Human Rights Commission Act (Law No. 6/2006).

Report of the Government Oversight Committee on its review of the four Cabinet ministers appointed by the President under Article 129(a) of the Constitution, submitted for the Majlis's consent as required by Article 129(d).
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: This special sitting was scheduled to send new Anti-Corruption Commission nominations to committee and to vote on committee reports approving a Human Rights Commission vice president and four new Cabinet ministers.
